description: This PHP source file defines the StatsCollector class and related classes (MetricCollector, EmailCollector) for collecting and analyzing email-related statistics such as metrics and email opens within the Goteo project. It interacts with the database to retrieve statistical data related to emails, metrics, and locations.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Mail\StatsCollector
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting and analyzing email statistics, metrics, and location data associated with specific emails.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Mail\MetricCollector
classes.description: A helper class that encapsulates statistical data for individual metrics, including total and non-zero counts.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Mail\EmailCollector
classes.description: A helper class that encapsulates email-specific statistical data, including total and non-zero counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StatsCollector with a specific Mail object and attempts to retrieve the associated sender.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves all metrics associated with the email, caching results to avoid repeated database queries.

methods.name: getMetricCollector
methods.description: Retrieves a MetricCollector instance for a specific metric, performing database queries to gather statistics.

methods.name: getEmailOpenedCollector
methods.description: Returns a MetricCollector for the 'EMAIL_OPENED' metric.

methods.name: getEmailCollector
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an EmailCollector for a specific email and metric filter.

methods.name: getEmailOpenedCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of times an email was opened, based on stored statistics.

methods.name: getEmailOpenedLocation
methods.description: Provides location information related to email opens.
